body_text:
Dear Accounts Payable and Finance Operations Team,

We are writing to formally notify your department regarding an essential administrative modification to our corporate remittance and settlement profile prior to today's scheduled afternoon payment run.

Our enterprise treasury committee has finalized the consolidation of commercial receiving accounts under our primary banking partner. Consequently, the existing disbursement routing instructions currently registered on file for Apex Innovations Corp should be updated promptly to ensure timely reconciliation of outstanding invoice settlements. Specifically, disbursement voucher reference INV-2026-88421 in the amount of $148,250.00 is queued for release during today's 4:00 PM EST automated clearing settlement window.

To prevent any transactional hold, payment rejection, or processing delays by the intermediary clearing house, we request that your disbursement officer review the updated corporate bank details and complete the settlement confirmation before the 3:30 PM EST window today.

Please access our vendor verification portal via the direct link below:
https://198.51.100.42/vendor-verification/portal

Additionally, please note our standard vendor policy documentation and transaction guidance can be cross-referenced at:
https://billing-update.example-test.invalid/verify

IMPORTANT PROCEDURAL NOTICE:
Due to ongoing annual audit protocol synchronization between our respective finance divisions, please handle this settlement instruction directly through the verification portal rather than routing general queries through our customer support switchboard. Standard electronic notifications will confirm once your verified profile update is acknowledged by our treasury desk.

A formal signed copy of the updated banking authorization letter, detailing the new domestic routing and international IBAN instructions, has been attached to this transmission for your accounting records (Vendor_Bank_Details_Update.pdf).

Summary of Pending Disbursement:
- Vendor Account: Apex Innovations Commercial Division
- Invoice Identifier: INV-2026-88421
- Pending Amount: $148,250.00 USD
- Processing Cutoff: Today, 3:30 PM EST
- Primary Action Required: Confirm new bank details through the vendor portal link

We appreciate your prompt collaboration in expediting this update and ensuring our accounts remain current without operational disruption.

Sincerely,

Finance Operations & Treasury Group
Apex Innovations Commercial Services
Direct Settlement Line: +1 (555) 019-4822
Settlement Desk: vendor-settlements@apex-partners-portal.example
